properties.tile_naming_evidence: P_XXXXX_OSOSOS_SDFLOWN_EDFLOWN.* includes unique survey id, OS grid reference, first survey date and last survey date

tile.binding_basis: Target EPSG:27700 centroid and SU57NE binding carried forward from prior verified accepted evidence; current metadata independently confirms National LIDAR Programme products use 5 km OS-grid-aligned tiles and tile names carry OS grid reference plus first/last survey dates.

field_evidence.dataset_identity: Official Environment Agency National LIDAR Programme metadata and identifier.
field_evidence.coverage: Official metadata states accurate elevation data at 1 m spatial resolution for all England.
field_evidence.tile_supply: Official metadata states all products are available in 5 km tiles aligned to the Ordnance Survey grid.
field_evidence.survey_dates: Official metadata states tile names include first and last survey dates and an index catalogue provides survey-specific information for each tile.
field_evidence.products: Official metadata defines DTM, DSM, first-return DSM, intensity surface model and point cloud products; surface models are GeoTIFF and point cloud is LAZ.
field_evidence.date: Official metadata reference period 2016-11-11 through 2023-05-05 and revision date 2023-12-15.
field_evidence.license: Official metadata states Open Government Licence and no public access constraints.
field_evidence.accuracy: Official lineage states vertical accuracy +/-15 cm RMSE.
